mt: It's said that the faithful don't know each other's names.
en: It comes up that your followers don't know each other's names.

ko: 지역 신문 기자가 교단을 취재하고 싶다고 합니다.
mt: A local newspaper reporter says he wants to cover the Faith.
en: A local reporter wants to cover the cult.

ko: 동네 쓰레기 줍기 봉사에 교단이 참여하자는 의견이 나옵니다.
mt: It's the opinion of a group to participate in the local garbage collection service.
en: Someone suggests the cult join a neighborhood litter pickup.

ko: 이웃 주민이 예배 소리가 시끄럽다고 항의합니다.
mt: Neighbors protest that it's loud.
en: A neighbor complains the worship is too loud.

ko: 구청에서 교단에 모범 단체 표창을 주겠다고 합니다.
mt: The hearing says we're going to give a model group sign to the school.
en: The district office wants to award the cult a model-organization citation.

mt: A flyer that slandered the Faith was scattered in the neighborhood.
en: Flyers slandering the cult have been scattered around the neighborhood.

ko: 지역 학교에서 교주에게 인성 강연을 부탁합니다.
mt: I'd like to ask the teacher to give a human speaking at the local school.
en: A local school asks you to give a character-education lecture.

mt: A great flood struck the neighboring village.
en: A great flood has struck the next village.

ko: 교단 신도가 도박에 빠졌다는 소문이 돕니다.
mt: There are rumors that members of the Faith are gambling.
en: Rumor has it a follower is hooked on gambling.

mt: The hearing director says he's going to visit the school during the election season.
en: The district head wants to visit the cult during election season.

ko: 교단이 운영하는 공부방 아이들이 상을 받았습니다.
mt: The kids in the study room, run by the Faith, got their awards.
en: Children from the cult's study room have won an award.

ko: 교단 행사로 길이 막혀 운전자들이 불평합니다.
mt: The driver complains that the bridge is blocked by a school event.
en: Drivers complain that a cult event is blocking the road.

mt: We're getting word from the media that we're going to deal with the cult.
en: A broadcaster contacts you about featuring the cult.

mt: I'd like to ask you to visit the school regularly at the nursing home.
en: A nursing home asks the cult for regular visits.

ko: 교단 건물 외벽이 낡아 동네 흉물이 되었다는 말이 나옵니다.
mt: It's been said that the walls of the bridge have worn out, and they've become a local evil.
en: People say the cult building's shabby exterior has become a neighborhood eyesore.

ko: 교단 신도가 길에서 지갑을 주워 주인에게 돌려주었습니다.
mt: The Shintoist picked up his wallet on the street and returned it to the owner.
en: A follower found a wallet on the street and returned it to its owner.

ko: 지역 상인회가 교단에 축제 후원을 요청합니다.
mt: Local Merchants request the cult's support of the festival.
en: The local merchants' association asks the cult to sponsor a festival.

ko: 이웃 교회 목사가 교단을 이단이라고 설교했다는 소식이 들립니다.
mt: We hear that the pastor of the neighboring church has preached that the church is a sect.
en: You hear a neighboring pastor preached that your cult is heretical.

ko: 교단 신도들이 헌혈 행사를 열자고 합니다.
mt: The Faith wants to have a blood transfusion event.
en: Your followers want to hold a blood drive.

mt: I'm going to go all the way to the end of my doubts.
en: Dig into the doubt to the end

ko: 의심을 파고들어 오히려 신앙의 근거를 다시 세웁니다.
mt: They dig into doubts, and they rebuild their faith.
en: Digging into your doubt, you rebuild the very foundation of your faith.

mt: It's so suspicious that I sleep all night long.
en: Your doubt only deepens, and you toss and turn all night.

mt: We pray more deeply.
en: Pray more deeply

mt: When I join the prayer, I calm down.
en: As you lose yourself in prayer, your heart settles.

mt: I pray, but I can't answer. I'm lost.
en: You pray, but no answer comes. You feel hollow.

mt: I'd like to talk to my superiors.
en: Confide in your inner circle

mt: They're comforting and they're praying together.
en: Your confidant comforts you and prays with you.

mt: To inform the believers.
en: Announce the Revelation to your followers

ko: 계시 이야기가 입소문을 타고 신도들이 몰려듭니다.
mt: There's a lot of believers coming to the news of a revelation.
en: Word of the Revelation spreads, and followers flock to you.

mt: There's a rumor that it's inexorable.
en: Rumors spread that it's preposterous.

mt: I keep it to myself.
en: Keep it to yourself

mt: Keep it quiet and hold it together.
en: You keep it quietly and steady your heart.

mt: It's just a dream.
en: Dismiss it as a dream

mt: It's just a dream. It sort of sort of sort of settles your mind.
en: Telling yourself it was only a dream, you set it aside.

mt: I organize the revelation into a doctrine.
en: Codify the Revelation as Doctrine

mt: I'm summing up the dream word in a doctrinal sentence.
en: You refine the words of the dream into Doctrine.

mt: Words are vague and uncluttered.
en: The words are too vague to set down.

mt: The faithful are required to contribute in exchange for the Revelation.
en: Demand offerings for the Revelation

mt: I make a sign, and I make a contribution.
en: You collect offerings in the name of the Revelation.

mt: The faithful rebel against the demand for donations.
en: Your followers push back against the demand.

mt: Three days of fasting.
en: Fast for three days

mt: After three days of fasting, my heart is clear.
en: After three days of fasting, your mind is clear.

mt: He's going down. He's going down.
en: Your strength gives out and you collapse.

en: Calling off the gathering weighs on you.

en: Your scolding silences him, but the mood turns icy.

en: The sworn call each other brother and sister.

mt: I pray to God with all my heart.
en: Pray for them wholeheartedly

en: The mother thanks you through her tears.

en: Have the cult cover the medical bills

en: The chapel fills with hymns of thanks.

mt: I'll raise your wages.

mt: The holiday visit is a great joy for the elderly.
en: Holiday visits bring the elderly great joy.

mt: There's a long story that doesn't come very often.
en: They're left feeling you don't come often enough.

mt: I'm re-painting the outer wall.
en: Repaint the exterior walls

mt: The locals are in favor of a well-known building.
en: Residents warm to the freshened-up building.

ko: 색이 너무 튀어 오히려 놀림을 받습니다.
mt: It's so colored that it's made fun of.
en: The color is so loud you get teased for it.

mt: I draw my paintings with the believers.
en: Paint a mural with your followers

mt: The mural becomes a local landmark.
en: The mural becomes a neighborhood landmark.

mt: I'm not good at drawing, so I'm laughing.
en: The painting skills fall short, and it becomes a laughingstock.

mt: The sermon commends you.
en: Praise him in your sermon

mt: Honesty becomes a cult's pride.
en: Honesty becomes the cult's pride.

mt: I'm ashamed of myself.
en: He is embarrassed.

mt: Report to local newspapers.
en: Tell the local newspaper

mt: There's an American story.
en: A heartwarming story runs in the paper.

mt: I hear you're proud.
en: People say you're showing off.

mt: Supported.
en: Sponsor them

mt: The merchants see the cult as a secure neighborhood.
en: The merchants see the cult as a dependable neighbor.

mt: The sponsorship money is used in the wrong way.
en: The donation gets misused.

mt: We help with the service force.
en: Help with volunteer labor

mt: Thank you for the sweaty service.
en: The merchants are grateful for your hard work.

mt: It's exhausting.
en: The work is grueling, and you wear out.

mt: We'll go to the pastor and talk to him.
en: Visit the pastor to talk

en: After talking, the pastor apologizes for the misunderstanding.

mt: Worse words come back.
en: You get even harsher words in return.

mt: Ignore it and work hard at good.
en: Ignore it and focus on good deeds

mt: The fruits of the cult speak louder than the horses.
en: The cult's fruits speak louder than words.

mt: Rumors spread in the neighborhood.
en: The rumor spreads through the neighborhood.

mt: I'm calling for a donor bus.
en: Call in a blood donation bus

mt: There are dozens of people kicking their arms.
en: Dozens roll up their sleeves.

ko: 헌혈 후 어지러워 쓰러지는 이가 생깁니다.
mt: And then you have this guy who's dizzy and falls.
en: Someone faints from dizziness after donating.

mt: He's giving blood first.
en: Donate blood first yourself

mt: The faithful line up along the way.
en: Following your lead, followers line up.

mt: They suffer from anemia for a few days.
en: You suffer from anemia for days.
